siteProfile.headline: Lead Full-Stack Engineer & Distributed Systems Architect
siteProfile.subheadline: Architecting resilient digital platforms, high-throughput microservices, and editorial web experiences.
siteProfile.shortBio: Colombo-based engineer balancing distributed systems reliability with architectural typographic craft.
siteProfile.extendedBio: I design and build distributed microservices, document intelligence engines, and high-fidelity web applications. At Onsys, I guide system architecture across enterprise banking integrations, real-time biometric identity gateways, and automated document analysis pipelines. My technical ethos combines strict algorithmic rigor, type-safe software design, and warm, tactile editorial aesthetics.

projects.title: CRIB Document Intelligence Platform
projects.summary: Distributed microservices engine for high-volume banking document verification and optical feature analysis.
projects.description: Architected an enterprise-grade document extraction pipeline capable of processing complex financial records, KYC validation, and biometric liveness checks in real-time. Built with Node.js microservices, Docker containerization, Redis pub/sub queues, and Azure Cognitive Services, delivering sub-second parsing with 99.8% verification accuracy.

projects.title: Dialog Telecom Biometric Liveness System
projects.summary: Real-time anti-spoofing facial recognition and identity verification gateway for telecom onboarding.
projects.description: Designed and integrated low-latency client-side frame processing with server-side 3D face mesh validation. Reduced fraud attempts by 99.4% across 2M+ active subscriber activations while ensuring WCAG AA accessibility compliance.

projects.title: IOM Automated Visa Logistics Portal
projects.summary: Secure immigration data management platform handling multi-jurisdiction applicant tracking.
projects.description: Architected end-to-end encrypted biometric case handling for international migration workflows, featuring automated PDF dossier generation, granular role-based access control, and tamper-evident audit trails.

projects.title: Kinesis Real-Time Financial Ledger
projects.summary: Event-sourced ledger accounting engine processing thousands of concurrent transactions with ACID guarantees.
projects.description: Built using CQRS patterns, Kafka streaming, and distributed locks. Features a Swiss-style minimal dashboard with live transaction graphing and instant reconciliation reporting.

experiences.description: Directing engineering strategy, architectural standards, and full-stack product development for enterprise fintech clients.
highlights: Spearheaded architectural evolution of CRIB Document Intelligence platform handling 500,000+ verification queries per month.
Engineered microservices backend utilizing Node.js, Redis queues, and Docker containerization with 99.95% uptime.
Established modern Next.js + TypeScript UI component system ensuring accessible and performant client interfaces.

experiences.description: Built high-frequency merchant payment processing gateways and administrative analytics dashboards.
highlights: Reduced core transaction query latencies by 45% through composite database indexing and in-memory Redis caching.
Implemented comprehensive CI/CD pipelines and unit testing suites cutting regression release cycles by 60%.

experiences.description: Developed responsive cross-platform web and mobile applications for international logistics and education partners.
highlights: Built native-feeling cross-platform mobile experiences utilizing Flutter and React Native.
Collaborated with product designers to implement Swiss design typography standards and tokenized design systems.
